name: dtc4eu-checks
description: Check runner for CONSTRAINTS.md (scripts only; each app keeps its own package.json / pom.xml)

scripts.check:fast: node scripts/floor-guard.mjs --base HEAD && bash scripts/secrets-diff.sh && npm --prefix frontend run -s typecheck && npm --prefix website/frontend run -s typecheck
scripts.check:diff-coverage: pipx run --spec diff-cover==11.0.2 diff-cover backend/target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml --compare-branch=HEAD --src-roots backend/src/main/java --include-untracked --fail-under=80
scripts.check:security: semgrep scan --quiet --config p/default --strict --json --metrics=off --exclude 'backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_roles.sql' --exclude 'website/backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_placeholder_content.sql' -o semgrep-results.json . && node scripts/quality-gate.mjs semgrep semgrep-results.json
scripts.check:deps: osv-scanner scan source -r --config osv-scanner.toml --format json . > osv-results.json; [ $? -le 1 ] && node scripts/quality-gate.mjs osv osv-results.json
scripts.check:bundles: npm --prefix frontend run -s build && npm --prefix website/frontend run -s build && node scripts/ratchet.mjs frontend && node scripts/ratchet.mjs website
scripts.check:task: npm run -s check:fast && npm run -s check:backend && bash scripts/soft-gate.sh 2026-11-30 npm run -s check:arch && bash scripts/soft-gate.sh 2026-11-30 npm run -s check:diff-coverage && bash scripts/soft-gate.sh 2026-11-30 node scripts/ratchet.mjs backend && bash scripts/soft-gate.sh 2026-11-30 npm run -s check:security
scripts.check:full: npm run -s check:task && node scripts/floor-guard.mjs --base origin/main && gitleaks git . -c .gitleaks.toml --redact --no-banner && npm run -s check:deps && bash scripts/soft-gate.sh 2026-11-30 npm run -s check:bundles
